_views.text: Quantum handles non-classical states in Luna. A sprite in stable state is sharp, solid, opacity 1.0. A sprite in superposé state has a Gaussian blur (stdDeviation 2), a ghost double at +10px offset, and sinusoidal opacity oscillation between 0.3 and 0.7. Superposition is triggered by CHAOS and resolved by HARMONIE or RÉPARATION. A sprite can only enter superposition when the Nucleus coherence allows it — checked via the 639 Hz pulse threshold.
